While the publication describes extensive in vivo rodent models using doxorubicin and EV-CPC treatment, the MS dataset (PXD022129) is a comparative analysis of the secretomes of these two cell lines. Therefore, the in vivo perturbations (doxorubicin) are excluded as they do not apply to the analyzed MS samples.
